title: Abstracting Over Technical Implementations (Infrastructure Axis)
pattern: Defining a trait that wraps a low-level, technical technology layer rather than representing a logical business domain operation.
why_bad: Callers remain highly coupled to the technical details of the library/database, defeating the purpose of abstraction.
detection: Trait named directly after a specific library or database type (e.g., `Sqlite`, `Redis`, `Kafka`) rather than domain operations (e.g., `SessionStore`, `MessageBroker`).
fix: Rewrite the trait to express domain-focused logic in terms of business entities.
source: Eric Evans, *Domain-Driven Design* (2003); Vaughn Vernon, *Implementing Domain-Driven Design* (2013).
